Pauses the program for a number of milliseconds. The window keeps working while it waits. A value of 0 or less returns right away.

```blitzbasic
;run
start = MilliSecs()
Delay 100
Print MilliSecs() - start >= 95
```

```text
1
```
@param millisecs  How long to wait, in milliseconds.
